newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Carryover demand possible but market looks overbought and cash markets weak.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Index up and corn called lower but may follow live cattle.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Cash seen steady to lower and pork cutout down but hot and humid weather into next week supportive.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to off 0.200 cent. July seen firm on light deliveries and spread support. But cash lower.
